# goslop text fixture — wrap-raise after a JS/pyodide bridge try body maps
# bridge failures to library exceptions (niquests pyodide FP shape)
lang: python
file: pyodide_adapter.py
---
def send(request, timeout=None):
    signal = None
    if timeout is not None:
        from js import AbortSignal
        signal = AbortSignal.timeout(int(timeout * 1000))
    try:
        js_response = run_sync(pyfetch(request.url, signal=signal))
    except Exception as e:
        err_str = str(e).lower()
        if "abort" in err_str or "timeout" in err_str:
            raise ConnectTimeout(f"timed out: {request.url}")
        raise ConnectionError(f"Failed to fetch {request.url}: {e}")
    return js_response
